rationale: First-person, unapologetic persona with concrete specifics: ribeye bone-in 16oz medium-rare, loaded baked potato, creamed spinach, mac and cheese, double bourbon neat, and directives to staff. The confident, no-apology tone and threat to send back a gray steak fulfill the rubric's highest band.
quote: I want the ribeye. Bone-in. Sixteen ounces. Cook it medium-rare—and I mean medium-rare, a little pink is not the same thing.
